problem_restatement: The v51 SOL route-native one-blocker observer censored its first exact attempt as technical_gap_unresolved even though source observations appeared dense around a brief websocket reconnect.

root_cause.finding: The observer treated every lifecycle-overlapping combined-channel StreamGap as unresolved without checking the exact mark and L2 observations that the replay actually consumes.

fix.behavior: An overlapping reconnect now remains resolved only when its mark crossing is within 5 seconds, its L2 crossing and declared L2 interval are within 15 seconds, and its declared bounds are complete. Missing, inverted, or over-limit paths still fail closed.

first_resolved_lifecycle.interpretation: This first resolved prospective lifecycle is negative evidence against removing the hourly-cross blocker. One lifecycle is diagnostic and does not establish final strategy expectancy.

validation.red_test: The bounded reconnect regression failed before the implementation because resolved_executions was zero.
validation.green_test: The bounded reconnect resolves while the existing 61-second missing-path regression remains technical_gap_unresolved.
validation.focused_suite: 61 tests passed across SOL evaluator, command, monitor, improvement ingestion, and hypothesis ledger.
validation.real_data_replay: PASS: resolved_evidence_available with one completed and one pending lifecycle.
validation.live_process_invariant: The v51 live backend was not restarted or modified.

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: A bounded observation cadence does not prove the continuous mark path between observations.
The one-blocker replay uses modeled IOC depth and exact recorded fees/funding but is not a placed live trade.
One negative short result is insufficient to reject every future one-blocker setup or infer long-side behavior.
A later unbounded or over-limit disconnect must continue to censor the affected lifecycle.
falsifiers: The immutable replay fails to reproduce the listed resolved execution or economics.
A bounded-gap regression resolves despite a mark interval over 5 seconds or an L2 interval over 15 seconds.
A missing or unbounded gap boundary becomes success-shaped instead of technical_gap_unresolved.
The live v51 strategy, sizing, risk, or execution behavior changes as a result of this report-only fix.

proposal_contract.1_recommendation: Retain the hourly-cross requirement and continue the predeclared route-native observer until the pending long and additional independent episodes resolve.
proposal_contract.2_why_now: The technical censor prevented the first exact prospective economics from entering the evidence loop.
proposal_contract.3_evidence_reviewed: Exact v51 SOL evaluations, WS L2, activeAssetCtx marks, declared stream gaps, funding history, and the source-bound immutable replay.
proposal_contract.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: A report-only path-quality bug hid a negative one-blocker lifecycle.
proposal_contract.5_applicable_market_regime: The resolved short candidate occurred with 1m, 5m, and 15m RANGE labels.
proposal_contract.6_alternatives_considered: Keep blanket censure, ignore all gaps, or reconcile only the consumed channels; channel-specific bounded reconciliation preserves fail-closed semantics.
proposal_contract.8_expected_upside: More complete prospective evidence and reduced risk of relaxing a useful blocker based on missing outcomes.
proposal_contract.9_main_risks_and_failure_modes: Sparse outcomes, modeled rather than placed fills, and unobserved movement between samples.
proposal_contract.10_validation_completed: Red-green regression, fail-closed control, focused suites, exact real-data replay, and observer restart.
proposal_contract.11_validation_still_required: Resolve the pending long lifecycle and collect more independent long and short episodes before any strategy recommendation.
proposal_contract.12_success_metrics: Every exact attempt is either source-resolved, explicitly pending, or rejected with a specific technical cause; economics survive costs and largest-winner sensitivity over multiple episodes.
proposal_contract.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any source contradiction, over-limit path incorrectly resolved, or effect on live authority requires immediate rollback of this report-only observer fix.
proposal_contract.14_confidence_level: High on the technical root cause and first replay arithmetic; low on strategy expectancy because N=1 resolved.
